project.title: Integrated Rural Service Hub Pilot for Farming Communities
project.objective: Design and pilot a multi-service rural hub that combines agronomic support, financial services, and administrative assistance for local farmers.
deliverables: Service model and process map for the rural service hub
Pilot site operational plan and staffing model
Compliance and risk checklist for hub operations
Post-pilot evaluation report with scale-up recommendations
constraints: Pilot must be designed and ready to launch within 30 days
All processes must comply with agricultural, financial, and public administration regulations
Limited budget for physical infrastructure changes at the pilot site
Services must be accessible to smallholder farmers with low digital literacy
Data handling must follow privacy and record-keeping standards
Operational hours must align with peak farming and harvest schedules

risks.risk: Low farmer adoption of the new hub services during the pilot.
risks.mitigation: Engage farmer representatives early, run field briefings, and adjust service hours and offerings based on initial feedback.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with administrative or financial regulations in bundled services.
risks.mitigation: Court administrator and branch managers review all procedures against regulations and maintain a compliance checklist for each service.

risks.risk: Operational overload on staff due to combining multiple services in one location.
risks.mitigation: Define clear role boundaries, stagger service introduction, and implement a simple triage and appointment system.

risks.risk: Data inconsistencies between agronomic records, financial records, and administrative files.
risks.mitigation: Standardize intake forms, assign data ownership per process, and schedule weekly cross-checks of key records.

risks.risk: Safety and crowd management issues during peak seasons at the hub.
risks.mitigation: Lieutenant designs a basic crowd and incident management plan and trains staff on emergency procedures.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures the hub’s processes, hours, and communication match real farming cycles and constraints.
Financial and administrative services must meet legal standards to avoid penalties and rework.
Combining services in one hub requires clear workflows and staffing plans to avoid bottlenecks.
Shared records across agronomy, finance, and admin must be consistent and auditable.
Peak-season traffic and cash handling require structured safety and incident procedures.
Clear metrics and feedback loops are needed to decide whether and how to expand the model.

backlog.task: Map farmer journeys and define core services for the rural hub
definition_of_done: At least three typical farmer profiles documented
End-to-end journey from field to hub mapped for each profile
List of priority agronomic support services agreed with stakeholders
Pain points and seasonal constraints captured in a short summary

backlog.task: Design overall hub service model and process map
definition_of_done: High-level process map covering agronomic, financial, and admin services created
Handoffs between roles clearly defined
Service catalog for the pilot version documented
Process map validated by agronomic crop production team leader and court administrator

backlog.task: Define compliance and documentation requirements for hub services
definition_of_done: List of applicable regulations for each service type compiled
Minimum documentation set per service defined
Compliance checklist drafted and shared
Branch managers confirm feasibility of documentation steps

backlog.task: Develop staffing model and shift schedule for the pilot hub
definition_of_done: Required roles and headcount per shift defined
Shift schedule aligned with farming and harvest hours
Coverage for peak days and emergencies planned
Schedule reviewed with agronomic crop production team leader

backlog.task: Create farmer onboarding and communication plan
definition_of_done: Simple explanation of hub services drafted in farmer-friendly language
Plan for field visits and group briefings created
Key messages aligned with branch managers and court administrator
Timeline for outreach before pilot launch agreed

backlog.task: Set up basic data capture and record-keeping templates
definition_of_done: Standard intake form covering agronomic, financial, and admin data created
Storage and access rules for records defined
Version-controlled templates shared with all roles
Data privacy considerations documented

backlog.task: Design safety, crowd management, and incident response plan
definition_of_done: Risk assessment for hub operations completed
Crowd flow and queuing guidelines documented
Incident response steps for health, security, and disputes defined
Staff briefing outline prepared and shared

backlog.task: Define performance metrics and feedback collection approach
definition_of_done: Key metrics for usage, satisfaction, and turnaround time listed
Simple farmer feedback form or script created
Reporting cadence and owners agreed
Metrics aligned with project objectives

backlog.task: Align agronomic advisory protocols with hub operations
definition_of_done: Standard agronomic advice topics for the hub defined
Guidelines for fertilisation, plant health, and harvest timing adapted for hub use
Referral rules for complex agronomic cases documented
Protocols shared with branch managers

backlog.task: Plan cash handling, security, and escalation procedures
definition_of_done: Cash handling flow and responsibilities documented
Security checkpoints and escalation contacts listed
Alignment with branch managers and court administrator confirmed
Quick reference card for staff drafted

backlog.task: Prepare pilot launch checklist and readiness review
definition_of_done: Checklist covering staffing, materials, safety, and data templates created
Owners and due dates assigned for each checklist item
Readiness review meeting held with all roles
Go/no-go status and open issues recorded
Pilot data and feedback collected from all roles
Compliance and incident logs reviewed
Key findings and improvement areas summarized
Recommendation on scale-up documented and shared

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on pilot scope, farmer journeys, and core services for the hub.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the rural hub pilot and asking for input on farmer needs.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final list of core services to include in the pilot hub.
Confirm the primary farmer profiles and journeys to design around.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define processes, compliance requirements, and documentation standards.
threads_plan.trigger: Court administrator shares initial compliance notes and asks for process inputs.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the minimum documentation set required for each service.
Decide on the standard intake form fields and data storage rules.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on staffing model, shifts, and daily operational routines.
threads_plan.trigger: Branch manager posts draft staffing plan and asks for feedback on coverage.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Finalize the shift schedule and role coverage for the pilot period.
Approve the daily opening and closing routines for the hub.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in safety, crowd management, and incident response procedures.
threads_plan.trigger: Lieutenant shares draft safety and incident plan for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final safety and crowd management plan for the hub.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot performance, feedback, and decide on scale-up approach.
threads_plan.trigger: End-of-pilot message sharing preliminary results and asking for reflections.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide whether to scale, extend, or stop the rural hub model and under what conditions.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in where each role posts status, blockers, and next steps for their tasks.
Weekly process review thread to adjust service flows based on early farmer feedback.
Pre-launch readiness huddle to walk through the launch checklist and confirm go/no-go.
Mid-pilot risk and safety review led by the lieutenant to update incident procedures.
Post-pilot retrospective to capture lessons learned and input for the scale-up proposal.
